crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not steal. “ ‘You shall not lie. “ ‘You shall not deceive one another.
For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity, nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth…
These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and…
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing…
One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…
There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are…
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…
but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would…
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

translations.web: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
translations.bsb: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
translations.kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
translations.asv: lie not one to another; seeing that ye have put off the old man with his doings,
